_comment: Direct ATS board slugs for job_search.py's greenhouse/lever/ashby sources. These hit each platform's own public job-board API directly, so the URLs returned are the real, direct apply links (no Adzuna-style redirect gate) — best for auto_apply.py's Greenhouse auto-fill, and faster/easier for manual apply on Lever/Ashby too. Unknown or renamed slugs just 404 and are skipped silently, so a wrong entry never breaks a run. Curated for data engineering / data platform / analytics engineering roles at companies known to pay well in that space.
